name: Light → Previous
description: These [Actions](https://esphome.io/automations/actions#all-actions) cycle through the effects configured for a light. `light.effect.next` advances to the next effect; `light.effect.previous` steps back to the previous one. The cycle wraps around at either end.

config_entries.label: Include None
config_entries.description: If `true`, "None" (no effect) is included as a step in the cycle, so the light passes through an un-effected state when wrapping around. If `false`, only the configured effects are cycled and "None" is skipped. Defaults to `false`.
